name: MTRX Document Studio
description: Professional document creation, publishing, and typography system. Built with modern styling, offline air-gapped security, citation formatting, executive briefing templates, and instant PDF export.
shortDescription: Next-gen typography and document editorial workspace
changelog:
• Native in-app vector PDF viewer (zero external 3rd-party apps required)
• High-performance asynchronous streaming engine for multi-megabyte files (>10MB)
• Memory-safe Undo/Redo engine preventing heap leaks
• Debounced background document statistics and word counter

name: MTRX Grid Pro

changelog:

• Sub-millisecond formula recalculation cycle
• Enhanced CSV and financial ledger export
• Modern dark theme high-contrast matrix grid
